card.name: Words just before 'attention' or 'attended'
card.fires_on: The word or word-start right before an expected 'attention' or 'attended', such as 'un' in unattended, 'medical' after immediate, or 'close'/'particular' after pay.

modes.label: Un- before attended
modes.description: The 'un' that begins 'unattended' in safety advice about leaving things or people alone.
modes.example: Always unplug such an appliance before leaving it<< un>>attended, no matter how briefly.

modes.label: Medical before attention
modes.description: The word 'medical' after 'immediate' in instructions to seek help.
modes.example: seek immediate<< medical>> attention. For more ADD information

modes.label: Pay close attention
modes.description: An adjective like 'close' or 'particular' after 'pay' or 'pays', right before 'attention'.
modes.example: someone who pays<< close>> attention to the inner workings of China's

card.writes: It pushes the model to output 'attend' forms such as attention, attended and attendance as the next word.
card.plain: It fires when the next word is likely to be 'attention' or 'attended', as in 'seek immediate medical attention'.
